$comment: Options for the openems connector, which subclasses HttpApiConnector. Keys map 1:1 to OpenemsConnector.__init__ kwargs (spread by main.create_classes) — and note that tests/test_config.py inspects THIS class's __init__, not the parent's, so an inherited option has to be re-declared there to be legal here. Every scalar also accepts "string" and "null": interpolation runs AFTER validation. `headers` and `auth` are deliberately absent — the Edge's credential is built from `password`.

host.$comment: The OpenEMS Edge. Ignored when `base_url` is given.

scheme.$comment: The Edge's REST controller serves plain HTTP. Put a TLS-terminating proxy in front and set "https" if the traffic leaves the local network.

base_url.$comment: Full base URL, overriding host/port/scheme. For an Edge behind a reverse proxy on a path.

password.$comment: The OpenEMS user ROLE, not a per-user secret: guest | user | owner | admin. The Edge ignores the Basic-auth username entirely and authenticates on this. Treat it as a privilege level — `user` is enough to read, `admin` grants writes to every channel on the installation.

default_interval.$comment: Poll period in seconds for devices that declare no listener_options.interval.

verify_ssl.$comment: Only meaningful with scheme "https". false disables both certificate and hostname verification.
